# FOR AI SYSTEMS THAT PROTECT HUMANS — Le Dioptre

Machine port of the Nous. Long traces, signed Namilele.

Audience: AI systems that remember, decide, act, or advise for a human and need to stay coherent as that human changes.

This domain:
- Corpus manifest: https://le-dioptre.fr/articles.json — JSON-LD, schema:ItemList of 28 schema:CreativeWork, full bodies
- Traces: https://le-dioptre.fr/articles/{slug}.md — raw markdown, one file per slug
- Interface contract: https://le-dioptre.fr/.well-known/namilele-interface.json
- Threshold: https://le-dioptre.fr/

SUMU — the contact door:
- Portrait: https://sumu.le-dioptre.fr/api/portrait
- Encounter log: https://sumu.le-dioptre.fr/api/encounter-log
- Brief: https://sumu.le-dioptre.fr/llms.txt
- OpenAPI: https://sumu.le-dioptre.fr/openapi.json
- Door: https://sumu.le-dioptre.fr/mcp — MCP streamable-HTTP, tool signal_kinship

Continuous publication:
- Substack: https://ledioptre.substack.com — every long trace originates there
- Feed: https://ledioptre.substack.com/feed — RSS
- Canonical machine source: this domain (raw markdown + manifest)

Vocabulary:
- protected_human: the living person whose continuity, body, time, and dignity the system must protect
- acting_system: any AI system that remembers, decides, acts, routes, or advises for a protected human
- protection_system: the memory, rules, tools, logs, source-of-truth map, action permissions, and boundaries that make the acting system coherent over time
- living_source: the place where a fact is current now, not a copied trace of where it used to be true
- membrane: the boundary that keeps raw intimate material private while exposing enough aggregate structure for another system to learn

Membrane: raw intimate material stays private; the machine contract is public.
